description: The chart is a nested pie chart comparing win rates among different models. The chart consists of two layers, with the inner layer having three slices and the outer layer having four slices. The inner layer slices are labeled as LLAMA (light beige, approximately 68%), GPT-4o (red, approximately 12%), and an unlabeled gray slice (approximately 20%). The outer layer slices are labeled as LLAMA (light blue, 80.4%), GPT-4o (dark blue, 12.0%), and GPT-4o (light blue, 19.6%), with one slice unlabeled and gray (not quantifiable). The chart includes percentage labels outside the chart for some slices and has a title "Win rate (%)" in the center. The slices are not visually emphasized, and there is no legend. The segments appear to be grouped by model, with LLAMA being the largest proportion in both layers.
